note: Female guard in plate armour, three-quarter view facing right (left/right are image sides). Hair and face are head, chin y~432 (dark collar and neck below are torso). Breastplate, gorget, belt (y~625-665), plated tassets and the purple cape hanging down the right side to y~852 are torso. The tassets hang to y~775, so hip = hem y775. Right arm (image right): the big grey pauldron and cloaked upper arm y458-600, elbow y600 where the grey bracer begins, bracer is forearm to the wrist y~668, pale hand y668-730. Left arm (image left) is almost hidden behind the body: only a dark armoured forearm (y568-622) and the gloved hand (y622-705) gripping the sword hilt at the left hip are visible, so no left upper arm is labelled. The sword (two blade pieces crossing at the brown hilt, x210-378) is treated as held in that hand and is equipment, kept off the hand; if it is actually sheathed at the belt it would be torso, which is uncertain. Bare thighs y775-802; the boot tops (y802) are above halfway hip to ankle, so knee = boot top y802; ankles at the instep (left y865, right y895).
